adjuster_notes: Inspected on 2023-05-22. Fire origin confirmed at the bookshelf area consistent with candle ignition of curtain fabric. Burn pattern on wall and ceiling limited to a roughly 8-by-6-foot area. Fire extinguisher discharge residue present confirming policyholder's account of self-suppression. Smoke damage extends into the hallway. Drywall, ceiling, bookshelf, curtains, and two upholstered chairs require replacement. Professional smoke remediation needed for the hallway. Full coverage approved under standard homeowner fire damage provision.
description: An unattended candle on the living room bookshelf ignited nearby curtains, which quickly spread flames to the bookshelf and a section of the adjacent wall. The policyholder extinguished the fire with a household fire extinguisher before the fire department arrived, limiting the damage to the immediate area. However, the living room sustained significant fire and smoke damage to the wall, ceiling, bookshelf, curtains, and surrounding furniture, and the hallway ceiling showed moderate smoke staining.
